card.name: Space before a number in references and ranges
card.fires_on: The space or small joining word just before a number in section cross-references, dose ranges, time limits and isotope names such as Tc 99m. It is also seen on the section number inside parentheses.

modes.label: Section and table references
modes.description: The gap or number right after 'Refer to Section', 'See Table' or a bracketed section number.

modes.label: Isotope names
modes.description: The gap between Tc and 99m in technetium product names.
